messages.text: Before anything, expand the PROJECT.md - which is very tracker centric - to full detector design
I’ll revise `PROJECT.md` around the full detector—tracking, calorimetry, muons, magnets, supports and services—while preserving the M0 gates and the simulation-focused level of detail.

`PROJECT.md` now covers the full detector in its scope, realism criteria, component hierarchy, validation programme and roadmap. The pixel module remains the first component case, while calorimeter, muon and magnet requirements enter the architecture work from the start. I also made the planned specification → generated DD4hep/XML → Geant4 validation workflow explicit, with its architecture and accuracy targets still open.

Expanded [PROJECT.md]([redacted] to cover the full detector:
